sentence: This project tries to find out how to deliver breast cancer prevention clinical trials to the community to improve access.
This project builds computational tools and machine learning models to design modulators that target protein-protein interactions.
This project uses genetic engineering to help islets withstand the stress of transplantation and resist immune attacks, without needing immunosuppression.
This project uses magnetic resonance imaging to study the brains of mouse models of Alzheimer’s disease and link the findings to human disease.
This project studies how a common type of mutation in endometrial tumors works together with estrogen signaling in endometrial cancer.
This project brings scientists together to advance understanding of how epithelial stem cells are regulated within tissues.
This project studies where small RNAs that build up before meiosis in maize are made, what they do and what they target.
This project examines social, epidemiological, environmental and ecological factors that influence access to hearing healthcare.
This project builds mesenchymal stem cell therapies, engineered with a chimeric antigen receptor, to calm immune system reactions in demyelinating diseases.
This project builds molecular probes that use hybridization chain reaction to image many RNA molecules at the same time.
This project studies how changes in astrocytes cause more inflammation and more alcohol drinking in an animal model of alcohol dependence.
This project studies how bacteria survive drug treatment long enough to gain antibiotic resistance through horizontal gene transfer or mutation.
This project studies how the tumor microenvironment affects the progression of colorectal cancer.
This project builds an inhibitor of an enzyme and tests whether it helps immunotherapy work better in ovarian and colorectal cancers.
This project studies the molecular and cellular workings of inflammatory processes.
This project uses brain imaging techniques to better understand the neurobiological bases of the addicted brain.
This project studies how repeated stretch remodels heart muscle, causing collagen buildup and stiffening in people with chronic coronary artery disease.
This project supports research on cell and gene therapy as a way to cure HIV.
This project provides imaging services to study cancer in mouse models and in patients, including magnetic resonance imaging and fluorescence imaging.
This project studies how long noncoding double-stranded RNA works in pathways linked to disease and to some forms of cancer.
